prompt_template:
Write the most precise title that names a category supported by every instance.

Interpret the quoted text within each instance together.

For each instance, ask yourself: "Given this instance alone, must it belong to the category named by this title?"

Instances:

{NUMBERED_INSTANCES}
question: Does requiring each instance independently to support membership avoid invented title restrictions and relationships, while retaining the most precise supported category?
evaluation: Interpret the quoted fragments of each single instance together.
Do not use other instances or full notes to supply missing support for an instance.
Judge category membership rather than requiring the same proposition in all instances.
A broader title caused by an underspecified instance is an intended concession, not automatically a failure.
Record unsupported specificity separately from avoidable loss of common specific meaning.
Do not require one exact title string; preserve alternative valid outputs and uncertainty.
comparison: Old v11 outputs are historical references only; no fresh v11 control in this test. Two runs per group probe variation, not representative accuracy.
execution: One fresh isolated subscription-authenticated codex exec process/thread/workspace per group and repetition; exact approved prompt with numbered unchanged quoted fragments; no schema, extra prompt text, examples, expected title, full notes, tool access or prior conversation. No automatic retries or best-of selection.
budget: Existing subscription only; no API-billed requests or new paid resources.
